description: LightGroup surface not shown with no light-group state. The resident-card light group is driven by sta_residentCardShow, which is set to CARD_LIGHTGROUP(2) only when val_residentCard==CARD_LIGHTGROUP(2). But val_residentCard is hard-coded to 1 (CARD_CURRENTTIME) under the ALWASYS_SHOW_UI else-branch at diAEControl.cpp L122 and is never assigned any other value, so sta_residentCardShow can never equal CARD_LIGHTGROUP and the LightGroup Draw/SetData body early-returns without producing a texture. The surface therefore cannot be shown through the can[]/mem[]/someip harness; it is undrivable to a true SHOW until the val_residentCard origin is re-based. This no-state case drives the master frame with no light-group signal active and asserts the negative label.
